key_findings: ✅ Strategy correctly identifies mean reversion points (RSI extremes)
✅ Consistent entries trigger during RSI < 30 (oversold) and RSI > 70 (overbought)
⚠️  Losing trades average -$52 while winning trades average +$32
⚠️  Overall -4.83% return despite high win rate indicates position sizing issue
⚠️  During strong trends, mean reversion stops get hit frequently

optimization_recommendations.issue: Losing trades are 63% larger than winning trades
optimization_recommendations.solution: Reduce stop loss from 2.5 ATR to 1.5 ATR, or use dynamic stops based on support/resistance

optimization_recommendations.issue: No trend filter - mean reversion fails in strong trends
optimization_recommendations.solution: Add 20/50 EMA filter - skip shorts in uptrends, skip longs in downtrends
optimization_recommendations.expected_impact: Reduce losses by 30-40%, improve win rate to 65-70%

optimization_recommendations.issue: Fixed position size ignores market volatility
optimization_recommendations.solution: Use Kelly Criterion or ATR-based position sizing
optimization_recommendations.expected_impact: Optimize risk/reward ratio, better capital preservation

optimization_recommendations.issue: Takes profits at first sign of mean reversion (RSI=50)
optimization_recommendations.solution: Scale exits: 50% at RSI=50, 50% at BB midline or 2xATR
optimization_recommendations.expected_impact: Capture larger mean reversion moves, +1-2% additional return

optimization_recommendations.issue: No volume confirmation for entry signals
optimization_recommendations.solution: Require above-average volume on RSI extreme bars
optimization_recommendations.expected_impact: Filter false signals, improve trade quality by 5-10%

next_steps: 1. Implement trend filter (20/50 EMA) to reduce losses in strong directional moves
2. Tighten stops from 2.5 ATR to 1.5 ATR and scale exits
3. Test on additional timeframes (4h, daily) for regime confirmation
4. Backtest with optimized parameters on 1-year history
5. Paper trade for 2-4 weeks before live execution
